**Issue #2972 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2972: Patch: the dungeon run asks before it throws away a run or a fight, and its map has a way back
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Three ways to lose dungeon progress by accident today:
- "Abandon the run" sits right beside "Continue the run" and ends a run several fights deep in one tap, with no question and no undo.
- During a fight, the browser's Back or a phone's back gesture silently drops the fight, which is dealt again from the first turn when you return.
- The run's map has no Back button at all, so on a phone the only way to the Play menu is the browser.

Once built, Abandon asks first, leaving a fight in progress asks and says the fight will start over, and the map has the same Back link as the run's start screen.

## Why
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.tsx:112`: `onClick={dungeon.abandon}`; `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts:468-475` (`abandonRun`) settles the loss and clears the saved run.
- Every other press that cannot be undone asks first: concede (`game/Game.tsx:570-573`), a token's redemption (`collection/TokenOffer.tsx`, R2480000), the chase Buy (`shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, R2683000).
- `dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:12-13`: "A fight is never saved (R2706000)", yet the screen has no leave guard. Practice asks before leaving a game (`routes/practice.tsx`'s leave dialog), and the online match holds every way off the board (`routes/match.tsx:329-344`, `guardLeaving` in `net/navigate.ts:40`, R2479000).
- `dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx:97-108` draws only the run's HUD and the phase's screen; the start screen (`StartScreen.tsx:414`) and the stats page (`stats/DungeonStats.tsx:304`) have a `BackLink`.

## Proposal
- Abandon: the first press asks in place, Cancel focused and Escape cancelling, as `TokenOffer` does; only Confirm calls `abandon`.
- Fight: `guardLeaving` while the fight has no result, with a question like practice's leave dialog minus its Save and leave, saying the fight starts over. It is released on the fight's result and on the store's own screen changes.
- Map: a `BackLink` to the Play menu; the run stays saved and the start screen offers Continue.
- Each new sentence gets its `zh-CN.json` entry (R711000), and a ruling note if the confirm needs one, as R2480000 got.

## Where it lands
`apps/web/src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/testids.ts`, their tests, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`; SPEC §15.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One click on Abandon does not call `abandon` and shows the question; Confirm calls it once; Cancel and Escape do not (the existing B19 test in `StartScreen.test.tsx` is updated to match).
- [ ] With a fight in progress, an in-app navigation is held and the question shown; Stay keeps the fight; once the fight has its result nothing is held.
- [ ] The run map shows a Back link to the Play menu, and following it keeps the run saved.
- [ ] The run map still fits one phone screen with its new Back link.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 6 files and their tests. The fight's guard has to release when the store, not a navigation, changes the screen (a result, Continue), or it would hold the run's own flow.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it.

Render `{leaving === null ? null : <ConfirmLeaveFight onStay={() => setLeaving(null)} onLeave={leaving.leave} />}` inside `Shell`. No `beforeunload`. The cleanup is what releases the guard on the store's own screen changes (Continue unmounts this screen); `!over` releases it on the result.
7. Map Back link: in `RunScreen.tsx` add `import { paths } from "../../net/navigate.ts"` and `import { BackLink } from "../../routes/nav.tsx"`, render `<BackLink to={paths.play} />` as the first child of the `dungeon-run-screen` div, exactly as `dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.tsx` does. Verify `t("Confirm")`, `t("Cancel")`, `t("Keep playing")` already have entries (they do; `grep` to confirm).
9. Tests: update `it("B19 a saved run offers continue or abandon")` in `StartScreen.test.tsx` to the new flow (first click shows `abandonAsk`, `abandon` uncalled; Confirm calls once; Cancel and Escape — copy the Escape dispatch from `collection/TokenOffer.test.tsx` — call nothing and close the question), and add `it("R2972000 abandoning a run asks first and only Confirm abandons", …)`. 10. Run: the three dungeon test files, `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (fails on any `t()` literal missing a zh-CN entry), typecheck and eslint on the touched files, and `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.test.tsx`: updated B19 test plus `it("R2972000 abandoning a run asks first and only Confirm abandons")` — question shown, `abandon` uncalled; Confirm calls once; Cancel and Escape call nothing and restore the Abandon button.
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx`: `it("R2972000 leaving a fight in progress is held and says the fight starts over")` — `navigate` held plus dialog shown; Stay keeps the fight; after the result `navigate` succeeds and nothing is held.
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx`: `it("R2972000 the run map links back to the Play menu and keeps the run")` — Back link targets `/play`; following it calls no store verb.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web exec eslint src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.tsx src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx src/dungeon/fight/ConfirmLeaveFight.tsx src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] One Abandon press shows the question and calls nothing; Confirm calls `abandon` once; Cancel and Escape call nothing.
- [ ] In-app navigation mid-fight is held with the start-over question; Stay keeps the fight; nothing is held once the fight has its result.
- [ ] The run map shows a Back link to `/play`; following it keeps the run saved.
- [ ] The run screen keeps its classes and scroll structure (no fixed-height change).
- [ ] All commands above pass, including `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- [ ] No rule in **Never** broken (no skipped/disabled tests, no new lint suppressions, no secrets).

## Risks

- The guard holding the run's own flow: the effect depends on `atStake` (`!over`) and its cleanup releases on unmount, so the report → Continue → `act` path never meets a guard. A dialog left open across unmount is cleared by the same cleanup, as `match.tsx` does.
- Back with the fight dialog open: `backLayers`' `popstate` listener runs before the guard's (`navigate.ts: onPop` checks `popBackLayer` first), so Back closes the dialog (Stay) instead of leaving — the same as Concede and the online-match dialog.
- `useBackLayer` pushes a history entry in browsers without `CloseWatcher`; inert in the dungeon tests' jsdom, but keep the `PracticeLeave` structure verbatim so behavior matches practice.
- zh-CN parameter tokens must match the English key exactly; the four new keys carry no `{…}` params, and the reused button keys already pass `i18n.test.ts`'s token check.
- `spec check` fails if any `R2972000` cited in code comments lacks the note, or any `proven_in` file lacks a running `R2972000` test — all three test files get one.

## Open questions

None. Every requirement is settled by the patterns named above (TokenOffer's inline ask, PracticeLeave minus Save, match's `guardLeaving`, DungeonStats' `BackLink`).
```
